scope: Engine-identified Game Master Everon: Morton, Montignac and Le Moule; unchanged diagnostic sampler exports three 40-by-40-metre sections, nine points each, then actual offline desktop/WebGL raycasts compare all 27 sampled heights and landmark world/map coordinates; no full-world terrain export
limits: Tested world is exactly GM_Eden.ent, whose engine-reported subscene is Eden.ent; no identity relabeling. Native landmark entity origins can differ from ground height, so ground is independently sampled. Actual satellite textures are not imported: UV bounds/orientation are separately tested, real image alignment remains a dataset acceptance requirement. Imported files remain unauthenticated.
